name: Three Lines Tattoo Deusto
bio:
Discover the inking mastery of Three Lines Tattoo Deusto, nestled in the heart of Bilbao, Spain. A creative sanctuary where artists like Valentino Mozzo and La Loca de los Gatos craft exceptional body art, ranging from the avant-garde to time-honored traditions. Step into this haven of self-expression and let the collective talent behind the names such as Tinta de Rana and Cactus Tattoo bring your skin to life with vibrant, storytelling tattoos.
Price: $
Current location: Bilbao, Basque Country, Spain
